query:
SELECT u.password_hash IS NOT NULL AS "has_password!",
                  count(p.id) AS "passkeys!",
                  count(p.id) FILTER (WHERE $2::uuid IS NULL OR p.id = $2) AS "deleting!"
           FROM users u LEFT JOIN passkeys p ON p.user_id = u.id
           WHERE u.id = $1
           GROUP BY u.id
